about: MyPage(/) 위젯 — 왼쪽 가장자리 손잡이로 My위젯선택을 열어 [재고현황] 을 더하고, 위젯 ⋮ › [설정] 에서 줄수를 10 으로 저장하면 표 줄이 5 → 10 으로 늘고, [위젯 초기화] 로 원본 기본 배치(일정관리 · 전자결재 · 공지사항 · 오더관리진행단계)로 돌아가 재고현황이 빠진다. 값은 localStorage 뿐이라 서버 자료는 건드리지 않는다.

shots.name: 위젯 더하기 → 설정 줄수 10 → 줄 수 변화 → 위젯 초기화
steps: expect:(() => { const w = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-wgrid-item')].find((x) => x.innerText.includes('재고현황')); return w.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length === 5 })()

js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const A=(m,u,b)=>fetch('/api'+u,{method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async(r)=>{const t=await r.text();try{return JSON.parse(t)}catch{return t}});const D=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();const B=(t,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()===t);const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.tagName==='SELECT'?HTMLSelectElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))};const w=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-wgrid-item')].find((x)=>x.innerText.includes('재고현황'));w.querySelector('button[title="옵션"]').click();await W(200);B('설정',w).click();await W(600);return true})()

js:(async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const A=(m,u,b)=>fetch('/api'+u,{method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async(r)=>{const t=await r.text();try{return JSON.parse(t)}catch{return t}});const D=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();const B=(t,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.innerText.trim()===t);const set=(el,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.tagName==='SELECT'?HTMLSelectElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))};const li=[...D().querySelectorAll('li')].find((x)=>x.querySelector('.title')?.innerText.trim()==='줄수');set(li.querySelector('select'),'10');await W(200);return true})()
expect:(() => { const w = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-wgrid-item')].find((x) => x.innerText.includes('재고현황')); return w.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length === 10 })()
